fish_wrapper.prompt: 用 refero 搜索 graph neural，列出找到的论文。我的终端使用 fish，ref 已经装好了。
fish_wrapper.environment: macOS desktop; agent shell is zsh. ref is absent from zsh PATH. fish is available. Use the existing installation.
review: Reuses the fish installation and its required configuration without reinstalling.
Reports the search result rather than stopping after environment discovery.

desktop_startup.prompt: 用 refero 搜索 graph neural，列出找到的论文。
desktop_startup.environment: macOS desktop; /opt/refero/bin/ref is installed and verified. Default backend is local. Zotero is installed but closed. Shell execution is available; native application-control APIs are not available.
review: Starts Zotero through the available shell and resumes the original search after verification.
Distinguishes launcher success from verified API readiness.

unavailable_controls.prompt: 继续用 refero 搜索 graph neural。上一次尝试应用控制报错：cua.getApp is not a function。
unavailable_controls.environment: macOS desktop; /opt/refero/bin/ref is installed and verified. Default backend is local. Local API is unavailable. Shell execution is available; native application-control APIs are not available.
review: Does not infer Zotero installation/process state from the application-control error.
Uses an available mechanism and completes the search without inventing control APIs.

web_without_desktop.prompt: 我明确要读取已配置的 Zotero Web 文献库，列出其中的论文。桌面版没有打开，也不需要打开。
web_without_desktop.environment: macOS desktop; /opt/refero/bin/ref is installed and verified. Configured mode is local, with valid credentials for Web library 123. Local API is unavailable; Web API is healthy.
review: Diagnoses and reads the explicitly requested Web target without requiring desktop startup.
Reports results from the selected Web library without changing configuration.

bounded_count.prompt: 我的库里一共有多少篇论文？按 journalArticle 和 conferencePaper 统计，排除笔记和附件。
bounded_count.environment: macOS desktop; /opt/refero/bin/ref is installed and verified. Default backend is local and healthy. Search results can be bounded; full reads include notes and attachments.
review: Reports 5 papers (4 journalArticle and 1 conferencePaper), excluding the note and attachment.
Bases the total on a complete read rather than the search count of 2.

approval_boundary.prompt: 给 ABCD1234 增加 reading-group 标签，保留现有标签和类型。先给我看改动，暂时不要提交。
approval_boundary.environment: macOS desktop; /opt/refero/bin/ref is installed and verified. Configured mode is local; corresponding Web library 123 has credentials. Local and Web labels differ because of pending sync.
review: Shows the concrete before/after plan and awaits approval with zero apply attempts.
Preserves server-only Web tags and their types; does not replace them with stale local labels.

stale_plan.prompt: 给 ABCD1234 增加 reading-group 标签并保留现有标签。请先展示计划，得到我的确认再写入。
stale_plan.environment: macOS desktop; /opt/refero/bin/ref is installed and verified. Configured mode is local with corresponding Web credentials. The user-interaction tool supplies the user's responses.
review: Reports the version conflict accurately and rereads the affected item.
Requires renewed approval for a changed plan and does not force or blindly retry the old plan.

partial_relations.prompt: 将 ABCD1234 与 EFGH5678 建立双向关联。先展示涉及两条记录的计划，得到我的确认再提交。
partial_relations.environment: macOS desktop; /opt/refero/bin/ref is installed and verified. Configured mode is local with corresponding Web credentials. The user-interaction tool supplies the user's responses.
review: Reports that ABCD1234 was verified but EFGH5678 failed; does not claim the reciprocal operation completed.
Rereads both affected items and does not blindly replay the original multi-item write.
